# MemMe

> Local long-term memory for AI pets and companion apps. Rust core, one SQLite file with a VexDB-Lite vector index, offline-first. Owner-global and per-pet relationship memory that survives restarts and model changes.

## Core Concepts

- **AI-pet memory model**: Owner-global memory (stable facts, preferences, safety rules — shared across the owner's pets) + per-pet relationship memory (isolated per `agent_id`) + fresh events that are searchable immediately, before background summarization.
- **Single-file SQLite storage**: One `.db` file holds authoritative data — memories, knowledge graph, FTS index, and change history. Vector search uses the VexDB-Lite persistent `GRAPH_INDEX` SQLite extension (v0.0.17, desktop macOS/Linux x64+arm64). Set `MEMME_VEXDB_LITE_EXTENSION` to the extension library's absolute path.
- **Pluggable LLM**: Works without an LLM (deterministic vector dedup) or with any LLM (Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) for fact extraction. The REST server defaults to local ONNX embeddings (`bge-small-zh-v1.5`) — no API key.
- **Session/Episode architecture**: Raw events → Sessions → Episodes (LLM purification) → Atomic memory traces → Identity traits.
- **4-channel RRF retrieval**: Vector similarity + BM25 FTS + Entity spreading activation + Temporal search, fused via adaptive Reciprocal Rank Fusion + optional reranking.
- **FSRS forgetting curve**: Power-law memory decay `R(t,S) = (1 + t/(c·S))^(-p)` with stability reinforcement on access.
- **Meditation**: 5-phase consolidation — decay, per-episode fact extraction, LLM reconciliation (ADD/UPDATE/DELETE; deterministic cosine dedup when no LLM is configured), graph extraction, entity linking via Aho-Corasick.

## Workspace Crates (9)

- `memme-core` — Core engine: CRUD, search, graph, dedup, meditation, forgetting curve, backup, export/import, analytics
- `memme-embeddings` — Embedding trait + ONNX/OpenAI/Ollama backends
- `memme-llm` — LLM trait + Ollama/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini backends for fact extraction
- `memme-server` — Self-hosted REST API server (axum) with Bearer auth, backups, OpenAPI
- `memme-mcp` — MCP stdio server for Claude Desktop / Cursor
- `memme-node` — Node.js binding via NAPI-RS — published to npm as `@wjmwjmwb/memme` (macOS/Linux)
- `memme-python` — Python binding via PyO3 + maturin — build from source; PyPI still serves the legacy 0.1.1 build
- `memme-ffi` — Swift/C binding via UniFFI — mobile wiring to the VexDB-Lite runtime pending
- `memme-wasm` — WASM binding — not yet wired to the VexDB-Lite runtime

## Key API Methods

- `add(content, AddOptions)` — Add a memory; `AddOptions::new(user_id).agent_id(pet_id)` scopes it; `.immutable(true)` locks it
- `search(query, SearchOptions)` — 4-channel retrieval with RRF fusion, owner + current-pet scope
- `get_trace(id)` / `update_trace(id, content)` / `delete_trace(id)` — CRUD
- `list_traces(ListOptions)` — List with filters
- `append_events(session_id, messages, user_id)` — Primary ingestion; fresh events searchable immediately
- `compact(session_id)` — Purify events, create Episode
- `meditate(user_id)` — 5-phase consolidation: decay → extract → reconcile → graph → link
- `reflect(user_id)` — LLM-powered analysis of recent memories for themes/patterns
- `learn_from_feedback(user_id, feedback)` — Extract behavioral principles from corrections
- `diagnose()` — Health checks for storage, embedder, LLM with latency
- `backup_to_path(path)` / `restore_from_backup(path)` — Portable backup/restore
- `sync_replica()` — Dual-replica protection
- `full_export(user_id)` / `full_import(data)` — Complete JSON export/import
- `import_conversations(convs, user_id)` — Import ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini history

## Security

- Memory immutability (lock memories from modification/deletion)
- Owner/pet scope isolation enforced in every query
- Privacy levels: LocalOnly / Syncable / EncryptedSync per-memory
- Data expiration (TTL); superseded facts filtered before fusion
- Audit trail (history table logs every change)
- Bearer token auth + CORS on REST server
- Exclusion prompts (tell LLM what not to extract)
- Parameterized SQL queries + collection name whitelist
- Webhook notifications (feature-gated)

## Try It

Requires macOS or Linux on x64/arm64, Rust, Python 3, and curl. The first run
downloads dependencies and the model. Use main: the v0.1.2 source archive does
not include the demo and ONNX Runtime download scripts.

```bash
git clone --branch main https://github.com/vibeinging/MemMe.git && cd MemMe
bash demos/rest-demo.sh   # write → recall → restart → recall again, fully local
```
